trends.name: Iran Escalation & Hormuz Strait Crisis
trends.summary: US-Israel strikes on Iran continue with fragmented F-35 imagery released; 50% of Iran's missile launchers and attack drones remain intact. Prediction markets show only 30% odds of Hormuz reopening before June 1, down sharply. Geopolitical uncertainty is driving energy prices higher and creating macro headwinds for Fed policy and unemployment.

trends.name: Energy Prices & Oil-Driven Inflation
trends.summary: Crude oil volatility continues 32+ days into Iran conflict, pushing mortgage rates up for fifth consecutive week and hitting airline operations. Fed's Williams confirms higher energy prices are affecting inflation and disposable incomes on both sides of mandate. Oil itself emerging as best hedge against oil-based inflation stocks.

trends.name: US Labor Market Deterioration
trends.summary: Job sentiment gap collapsed to 5.8 points in March (lowest since 2020), signaling weakening labor demand. Fed expects 'more modest hiring' with 'low hire, low fire' stable unemployment outlook. Forward-looking data points to further unemployment increases amid stagflation concerns heading into NFP report.

trends.name: Private Credit Liquidity Crisis
trends.summary: Investor redemptions from private-credit funds intensifying, creating prolonged pressure on firms that dominated Wall Street in recent years. Fed's Williams monitoring closely but doesn't see systemic risk yet. Market repricing in private credit is creating spillover effects across credit markets.

trends.name: AI & Semiconductor Sector Momentum
trends.summary: Japan's Sakura Internet jumped 20% on Microsoft's announced $10B AI investment with SoftBank. Microsoft executives touting Copilot sales traction despite broader AI anxiety. Iran's threats against US tech companies ($NVDA, $AAPL) create geopolitical risks for semiconductor giants.

trends.name: Fed Policy Uncertainty & Inflation Target
trends.summary: Fed faces conflicting pressures: energy-driven inflation vs. weakening labor market. Fed's Williams emphasizes achieving 2% inflation target as 'critical,' but energy surge from Iran war complicates timeline. Market confused on whether Fed can engineer soft landing amid stagflation signals.

trends.name: Retail Consumer Weakness & Pricing Power
trends.summary: Starbucks turnaround moves failed to boost stock despite strategic shifts. Sam's Club hiking membership fees with Costco/BJ's likely to follow; United Airlines raising checked bag fees by $10. Companies testing pricing power as consumer sentiment weakens amid energy cost inflation.

trends.name: Market Breadth Deterioration & Cracks
trends.summary: Charts show widening cracks in stock market breadth despite headline indices holding. Ed Yardeni calls Monday as market bottom, but underlying breadth weakness suggests investor caution. Tesla stock falling on delivery sacrifices; market bifurcation deepening between mega-cap AI winners and broad market.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk & War Crime Allegations
trends.summary: US experts alleging American strikes on Iran may constitute war crimes, escalating diplomatic fallout. Trump threatening to destroy Iran bridges/power plants; IRGC releases F-35 shootdown footage. Geopolitical escalation creating uncertainty for defense contractors, oil markets, and US foreign policy.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO & Musk Portfolio News
trends.summary: Walter Isaacson discussing SpaceX IPO implications for Elon Musk's company portfolio. Market focus on potential public offering and valuation of privately-held SpaceX amid broader uncertainty around Musk's ventures.

trends.name: Sector-Specific Moves: Logistics & Specialty Names
trends.summary: GXO Logistics rated a buy despite macro risks; Kuehne+Nagel deemed unattractive. Montana Aerospace, Eldorado Gold, and Lynas Rare Earths showing mixed signals. Biotech (Zenas BioPharma) and specialty ETFs (WTV) outperforming as investors rotate into value.

trends.name: Trump Administration Policy Chaos & Regulatory Changes
trends.summary: Trump fires Pam Bondi after 'Dow over 50K' comment; administration sets 100% tariffs on imported drugs with selective exemptions creating uncertainty. Tiger Woods incident revelations add political distraction. Warner/Schiff probing insider trading in government circles.
